blocks.text: Condo buildings in North Shore Pt Moody
Streets, schools and transit near North Shore Pt Moody condos

items.t: "North Shore" here is a real estate board area name, not an official City of Port Moody neighbourhood name. The Official Community Plan areas along the north side of the Port Moody Arm of Burrard Inlet are Ioco, Pleasantside and April Road, plus the Heritage Mountain area (Heritage Mountain, Twin Creeks, Noons Creek, Mountain Meadows, Heritage Woods).

Where the condos are: not on the north shore. The Official Community Plan describes Pleasantside and April Road as mainly single detached homes, and the Heritage Mountain area as single detached homes and townhouses with a small number of apartments. Apartment buildings are at Inlet Centre and Moody Centre, south of the inlet, and that's where almost all of Port Moody's condos are.

Roads and transit: Ioco Road is the primary traffic corridor for the north shore neighbourhoods, connecting south to St. Johns Street, Barnet Highway and the Moody Centre and Inlet Centre stations; TransLink buses run along Ioco Road to Moody Centre Station (Millennium Line Evergreen Extension and West Coast Express).

Parks and recreation: Old Orchard Park is on the north shore and is a starting point for the Shoreline Trail, with Port Moody's only swimming beach (salt-water); Old Orchard Hall is at 646 Bentley Road, and the Port Moody Recreation Complex is at 300 Ioco Road.

Heritage: the Ioco townsite on the north shore is a heritage conservation area, where a heritage alteration permit can be required for changes; the townsite was built for Imperial Oil refinery workers.
Health: Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody (Fraser Health), south of the inlet, is the in-city hospital.

blocks.text: Good to know about North Shore Pt Moody condos

items.t: "North Shore" is a listings label, not a place the City plans by. A buyer searching City documents for "North Shore" will find nothing — the OCP plans this shore as Ioco, Pleasantside/April Road and the Heritage Mountain grouping, under OCP Bylaw 2026, No. 3522 (adopted April 28, 2026, repealing No. 2955, which older packages still cite).
The Bentley (295 Guildford Way, Newport Village) is sometimes listed in this area, but it's at Inlet Centre, south of the inlet.

One road in, one road out. Ioco Road is the primary corridor for every north shore neighbourhood; there is no second through-route, so showings, school runs and the commute all run on one road — and Port Moody's only swimming beach (Old Orchard Park, salt-water) is reached on it too.

A landslide site is the shore's only apartment pipeline — and it is years out. 38 Shoreline Circle was designated for multi-family use but postponed after a 1994 landslide on the site; the current 61-home application (submitted spring 2026) proposes permanent slope stabilization, with a hearing anticipated in spring 2027 and construction proposed for summer 2028. It is an application, not a presale.
OCP Section 14.4 addresses future planning for the former Imperial Oil (Ioco) lands.

Port Moody taxes and utilities are billed separately. Property taxes for 2026 were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after July 2 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; the 2026 utility bill was due February 27, 2026.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in North Shore Pt Moody
Streets, schools and transit near North Shore Pt Moody townhomes

items.t: "North Shore" is a real estate board area name, not an official City neighbourhood name. The Official Community Plan areas along the north side of the Port Moody Arm of Burrard Inlet are Ioco, Pleasantside and April Road, plus the Heritage Mountain area.

The few townhouses are along Ioco Road in Pleasantside, according to the Official Community Plan; condo buildings are at Inlet Centre and Moody Centre, south of the inlet. Ioco Road is the only through road, connecting south to St. Johns Street, the Barnet Highway and Moody Centre and Inlet Centre stations.
Schools: SD43 Coquitlam, address-based. Ministry-listed schools on the north shore include Pleasantside, Aspenwood, Heritage Mountain and Mountain Meadows elementaries.

Parks, recreation and health: Old Orchard Park (Port Moody's only swimming beach, salt water, and the start of the Shoreline Trail), Old Orchard Hall (646 Bentley Road), Port Moody Recreation Complex (300 Ioco Road) and the library (100 Newport Drive). Eagle Ridge Hospital is at 475 Guildford Way, south of the inlet.
Heritage: the Ioco townsite is a heritage conservation area — a heritage alteration permit can be required.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in North Shore Pt Moody

items.t: For any Port Moody strata, including a future Sentinel Hill purchase, read the Form B: monthly fees, amounts owing, approved special levies, the contingency reserve balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, budget, rental disclosure and latest depreciation report. The strata must provide it within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page.

Taxes, rebates and financing: property transfer tax is 1% on the first $200,000, 2% up to $2 million and 3% above, plus another 2% on the residential part above $3 million. First-time buyers are exempt on the first $500,000 for homes up to $835,000, with a partial exemption up to $860,000; the newly built home exemption is full up to $1,100,000 and ends at $1,150,000. For example, at $715,000 (Port Moody's September 2026 condo and townhome median) with no exemption, the tax is $2,000 + $10,300 = $12,300. The first-time buyers' GST rebate (law since March 13, 2026) covers all the GST on a new home up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out at $1.5 million, for agreements from March 20, 2025 to 2031; the GST New Housing Rebate is 36% up to $6,300 (phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000). The Home Buyers' Plan allows $60,000, an FHSA $8,000 a year up to $40,000, and CMHC premiums run 0.6%–4.5%. GST applies to new homes, not resales, and Vancouver's Empty Homes Tax doesn't apply.
